description: Turn an already-consented YouTube channel into a destination a stream can publish to, with managed broadcasts (update_stream's `youtube` settings, get_stream_live_stats). Takes the channel `id` from list_youtube_channels — NOT the YouTube channel URL or handle. If that list is empty, the account has not consented yet: start_youtube_connection first.

channelId.description: The `id` of a channel from list_youtube_channels.

name.description: Display name for the destination. Defaults to the channel title.

name: create_youtube_destination

code.description: Stable — branch on it: INVALID_INPUT, REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_PUBLISH, CONFIRM_REQUIRED, UNAVAILABLE, …

currentRevision.description: CONFLICT: the revision it has now

detail.description: What is wrong, in a sentence

errors.description: Each problem, when a check refused it

title: Create YouTube destination
